items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: And I know him so well! ... Him and Hinton and this tall fellow plays...

ctx.x: Do you remember the name of the bass player?

No. I couldn't think of it the last time I was talking to you about it. And I know him so well! He's one of the big ones. I mean, he's always working downtown, I mean all the time. Him and Hinton and this tall fellow plays...
